hero.subtitle: Software Engineering Lead
hero.greeting: Hi, I'm Ernesto. I prefer to be called Neto.
hero.description: Leading multidisciplinary teams and orchestrating high-impact technological solutions for over 11 years.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: I am a multidisciplinary person. Most of my time is spent managing teams, interacting with clients, managing projects, developing, and enjoying my family.
about.p2: I don't like to define myself by the work I have done. I define myself by the goals I want to achieve. Skills can be learned at any time, personality is inherent. I prefer to keep learning, keep challenging myself and do interesting things that matter that really add value to society and my family.
